summary: About 335 s of music in four sections with full-length lyrics, through templates/minimax/music-long.
description: Long-form bench S6 rerun after the music-long trim fix (237ee307), with about 10-12 lyric lines per 85 s section so each section can fill its length (the 4-line lyrics of music-long-s6.json gave 27-70 s): composes templates/minimax/music-long by its catalog name with four 85 s sections (each generated at a 128 s ceiling, 1.5 x seconds per the Music 3 skill), so the joined piece is about 335 s, past one Music 3 track's 300 s. Every caption repeats the same style tags, key and tempo. What to read: key, tempo, instrumentation and mix at each of the three crossfades (music-long's description says continuity is not guaranteed), and the level step at each join. A joined_short warning, or none, says whether every section reached 85 s.

sections.name: verse_1
sections.caption: slow cinematic folk, solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar, low cello, soft brushed snare, warm intimate male baritone vocal, D minor, 72 BPM, close dry mix, a sparse opening, guitar and voice only, the cello entering late
sections.lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
One hundred stairs and twelve more still
Iron worn smooth beneath my heel
My father climbed them, so will I
I light the lamp against the sky
The oil is low, the wick is new
I trim it like he taught me to
Salt on the glass, I wipe it clear
The only work that matters here
[pre-chorus]
And the dark comes down the water
And the dark comes to the door

sections.name: chorus_1
sections.caption: slow cinematic folk, solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar, low cello, soft brushed snare, warm intimate male baritone vocal, D minor, 72 BPM, close dry mix, the band fills in, brushed snare steady, the cello carrying the melody under the voice
sections.lyrics:
[chorus]
Turn, light, turn across the water
Every eight seconds, find them there
Turn, light, turn for someone's daughter
Someone's son out in the air
[post-chorus]
Turn, turn, the long night through
Turn, turn, I'm turning for you
[chorus]
Turn, light, turn across the water
Every eight seconds, find them there

sections.name: verse_2
sections.caption: slow cinematic folk, solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar, low cello, soft brushed snare, warm intimate male baritone vocal, D minor, 72 BPM, close dry mix, the storm verse, the snare busier, the cello low and urgent, the voice strained
sections.lyrics:
[verse]
The wind came first across the point
It shook the bolt in every joint
A lantern swinging, small and low
I counted forty, let it go
The rain came sideways off the sea
It found the cracks it left for me
I held the rail and climbed again
And kept the beam on all the men
[bridge]
Somewhere a sail, somewhere a hand
Somewhere a light they understand

sections.name: chorus_2
sections.caption: slow cinematic folk, solo fingerpicked acoustic guitar, low cello, soft brushed snare, warm intimate male baritone vocal, D minor, 72 BPM, close dry mix, the last chorus then a quiet outro, the band drops away to guitar and cello, a soft ending
sections.lyrics:
[chorus]
Turn, light, turn across the water
Every eight seconds, bring them home
Turn, light, turn for someone's daughter
No one out there sails alone
[chorus]
Turn, light, turn across the water
Every eight seconds, bring them home
[outro]
Bread and honey on the stair
I never asked who left them there
The morning grey, the water still
One hundred stairs and twelve more still
